approximations: same-position block only: paths from earlier positions' layer-l states through attention are excluded, so the reported rank lower-bounds the full Jacobian rank
local linearisation at sampled positions on sampled sequences; it describes infinitesimal sensitivity, not the model's behaviour under finite intervention
the activation subspace is the centred covariance over the evaluation split's scored positions, so the mean residual direction is reported separately
spectra are computed in float64 from a float32 backward pass; singular values below the recorded relative floor are treated as numerical zero
claims_not_supported: that a direction inside the top-J subspace but outside the activation subspace encodes any particular content
that a large blind-variance fraction is empirical rather than, for arms with vocab_size - 1 < d_model, largely forced by the algebraic rank bound
formulation.estimand: J = d logits(position q) / d h_l(position q), the same-position block of the final-logit Jacobian with respect to the layer-l residual stream
formulation.factorisation: logits = W_U n + b_U with n = ln_f(h_final), so J = W_U M with M = d n / d h_l computed exactly by d_model reverse-mode passes
formulation.logit_space: W_U is centred over the vocabulary before any rank statement, because adding a constant to all logits leaves the predictive distribution unchanged
formulation.spectral_route: J^T J = M^T (W_U~^T W_U~) M, a d_model x d_model symmetric eigenproblem

matched_compute.statement: cohort size, relative-depth grid size, tuned-lens optimisation steps and batch size, Jacobian probe count and the number of reverse-mode columns per probe (exactly d_model) are identical across arms; wall-clock and FLOP cost differ because vocabulary size and width differ, and that difference is the object of study

measurability.off_distribution_rule: clean cross-entropy exceeds the cohort unigram entropy

scored_positions.rule: attention-mask-valid next-token targets belonging to the cohort's own content; for EC-conditioned ZymCTRL the conditioning prefix and the terminator are excluded, following src.transfer.budget

thresholds.minimum_context_information_provenance: src.transfer.budget.MIN_CONTEXT_INFORMATION_NATS; recorded but not used to skip scoring, only the off-distribution rule skips an arm

training.identity_layer_rationale: the deepest residual stream is the final state, so the identity translator attains the objective's global minimum of zero exactly; it is held there rather than optimised
training.parameterisation: h -> h + A h + b, A and b zero-initialised
